events.title: Server Move - Progress Update
events.description: Omniscient continued the HF backend upgrade with rolling progress updates. Some real-life delays slowed things slightly, but progress is steady.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to Тоху, Deadly Toaster, and McDolands. SportsBook awarded to Walter.

events.title: Fuck, Marry, Kill: HF Edition
events.description: Hackers kicked off a chaotic Lounge chain thread that mutated mid-stream into 'Hack, Rob, or Kill' — pure HF banter, low stakes, high improv energy.

events.title: What's a Random Skill You're Surprisingly Good At?
events.description: R5N3T opened a wholesome prompt that pulled in answers ranging from speed reading and body language to box-fort building, storytelling photography, and the cursed superpower of always losing at gambling.

events.title: Forester: Game Alpha Demo
events.description: Hackers shared a playable alpha demo of Forester — a web-based crafting/combat game built with Codex featuring gathering, crafting, potions, procedural maps, and planned tier system. Framed as a passion project for his wife.

events.title: 4 Years Vape Free
events.description: tafatag shared what worked in their long-haul vape quit: replacing the habit (sunflower seeds/candy), breathing exercises to mimic the deep-hit ritual, and therapy to ride out cravings — practical guidance backed by community support.

events.title: Hi I'm new here and here is how I found you
events.description: Omega Sapien introduced themselves, explaining they discovered HF while exploring local AI tools — a reminder that members still find the site by wandering the internet for interesting corners to learn in.

events.title: 100,000 Bytes Contest
events.description: Moooookie is hosting another 100,000 bytes giveaway for upgraded members, ending March 8.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Cha Cha Real Smooth
events.description: RangoWorld submitted Cha Cha Real Smooth as Movie of the Week, calling it bittersweet and well-fitted to the month.
